original.statement: Legacy repository configuration in the argocd-cm ConfigMap (repositories, repository.credentials, helm.repositories) is removed in Argo CD 3.0; repositories must be converted to Secrets.

decision.reason: [ev-ea324615706c] says the legacy repository configuration in the argocd-cm ConfigMap "is no longer available in Argo CD 3.0", and its detection command reads `.data.repositories` from argocd-cm. That makes config-key path=repositories, component=argocd-cm, with change type removed, the right reading. The same section also removes repository.credentials and helm.repositories, which are separate keys and do not make this assertion wrong.
